translation: about, approximately; (in questions) by any chance

sentences.text: Er ist etwa zehn Jahre alt.
Wir waren etwa fünf Stunden dort.
sentences.en: We were there for about five hours.

sentences.text: Sie wohnt etwa zehn Minuten von hier.
sentences.en: She lives about ten minutes from here.

sentences.text: Nach Berlin brauchen wir etwa vier Stunden.
sentences.en: It takes us about four hours to get to Berlin.

sentences.text: Er ist etwa so alt wie ich.
sentences.en: He's about as old as me.

sentences.text: Es waren etwa zehn Leute da.
sentences.en: There were about ten people there.

meanings.gloss: (in questions) by any chance, surely not (surprise or suspicion)

sentences.en: You don't want to leave already, do you?
Are you saying you don't believe me?
Is that your car, by any chance?
sentences.review: Etwa here signals surprise or suspicion, not a neutral polite 'by any chance' (that would be 'zufällig' or 'vielleicht'), so the translation misses the nuance; suggest 'Don't tell me that's your car?' The 'by any chance' wording in the gloss should be reconsidered for the same reason.

sentences.text: Du willst doch nicht etwa allein fahren?
sentences.en: You're not seriously going to drive alone, are you?
